class.name: ECSQuery
class.brief_description: A cached entity query over an [ECSWorld].
class.description: Created with [method ECSWorld.query]. A query matches every entity that has all of the included components and none of the excluded ones. Matching is done per archetype with bitset operations and the result is cached: only archetypes created since the last use are tested again, so iterating a query is O(matching entities). For bulk processing from scripts prefer [method get_field_array] / [method set_field_array] over per-entity calls.

method.name: count
method.description: Returns the number of matching entities.

method.name: for_each
method.description: Calls [param callable] with the id of every matching entity. The set of entities is captured before iterating, so the callable may add or remove components or destroy entities.

method.name: get_entities
method.description: Returns the ids of every matching entity.

method.name: get_exclude
method.description: Returns the names of the excluded components.

method.name: get_field_array
method.description: Returns the value of [param field] for every matching entity, in the same order as [method get_entities]. Returns a packed array when the field type allows it ([PackedFloat64Array], [PackedInt64Array], [PackedVector2Array], [PackedVector3Array], [PackedVector4Array], [PackedColorArray], [PackedByteArray] for [bool]) and an [Array] otherwise. This is the fastest way to read many components from a script: values are copied straight out of the archetype columns.

method.name: get_include
method.description: Returns the names of the included components.

method.name: get_world
method.description: Returns the world this query belongs to.

method.name: matches
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param entity] matches the query.

method.name: set_field_array
method.description: Writes [param values] (an [Array] or packed array) into [param field] of every matching entity, in the same order as [method get_entities], and marks the components changed. Returns the number of entities written.
